name: event.pull
description: Reads the brand's outlet's events from Mission Events for a window of Singapore days (tentative, confirmed and completed) and makes the brand's copy of that window match: new and changed events are kept, events the feed no longer returns are removed. Events before the window keep their last state. An effect on the mission_events connector, which only reads; A feed whose outlet changed since the read keeps its rows. event.tick calls it hourly with the yes of the person who started the feed.
payload:
select jsonb_build_object(
  'brand', f.brand_id, 'at', :at::text,
  'path', '/api/v1/internal/marketing/events',
  'query', jsonb_build_object('from', :from::text, 'to', :to::text,
    'status', jsonb_build_array('tentative', 'confirmed', 'completed')),
  'keep', jsonb_build_object('outlet_id', f.outlet_id::text)) as result
from brandbase.event_feeds f where f.brand_id = :brand
sql:
with feed as (
  select f.brand_id, f.outlet_id from brandbase.event_feeds f where f.brand_id = :brand
    and f.outlet_id::text = :payload::jsonb -> 'keep' ->> 'outlet_id'
),
got as (
  select e from jsonb_array_elements(case when jsonb_typeof(:outcome::jsonb -> 'items') = 'array'
    then :outcome::jsonb -> 'items' else '[]'::jsonb end) e
),
parsed as (
  select distinct on (e ->> 'id') e ->> 'id' as id, left(e ->> 'name', 300) as name, e ->> 'status' as status,
    nullif(e ->> 'event_type', '') as event_type,
    brandbase.source_instant(e ->> 'date_start') as starts_at,
    brandbase.source_instant(e ->> 'date_end') as ends_at,
    coalesce(e -> 'is_all_day' = 'true'::jsonb, false) as all_day,
    nullif(e ->> 'room_name', '') as room_name,
    case when jsonb_typeof(e -> 'guest_count') = 'number' and (e ->> 'guest_count')::numeric between 0 and 100000
      then trunc((e ->> 'guest_count')::numeric)::integer end as guest_count
  from got, feed
  where jsonb_typeof(e) = 'object' and lower(e ->> 'outlet_id') = feed.outlet_id::text
    and nullif(e ->> 'id', '') is not null and nullif(e ->> 'name', '') is not null
    and e ->> 'status' in ('tentative', 'confirmed', 'completed')
  order by e ->> 'id'
),
good as (
  select * from parsed where starts_at is not null
),
up as (
  insert into brandbase.events (brand_id, id, name, status, event_type, starts_at, ends_at, all_day,
    room_name, guest_count, pulled_at)
  select :brand, g.id, g.name, g.status, g.event_type, g.starts_at, g.ends_at, g.all_day, g.room_name,
    g.guest_count, :now::timestamptz from good g
  on conflict (brand_id, id) do update set name = excluded.name, status = excluded.status,
    event_type = excluded.event_type, starts_at = excluded.starts_at, ends_at = excluded.ends_at,
    all_day = excluded.all_day, room_name = excluded.room_name, guest_count = excluded.guest_count,
    pulled_at = excluded.pulled_at
  returning id
),
gone as (
  delete from brandbase.events x using feed
  where x.brand_id = feed.brand_id and jsonb_typeof(:outcome::jsonb -> 'items') = 'array'
    and not exists (select 1 from good g where g.id = x.id)
    and (x.starts_at at time zone 'Asia/Singapore')::date <= :to::date
    and (coalesce(x.ends_at, x.starts_at) at time zone 'Asia/Singapore')::date >= :from::date
  returning x.id
),
landed as (
  update brandbase.event_feeds f set pulled_at = :now::timestamptz
  from feed where f.brand_id = feed.brand_id and jsonb_typeof(:outcome::jsonb -> 'items') = 'array'
  returning f.brand_id
)
select jsonb_build_object('brand', :brand, 'events', (select count(*) from up),
  'removed', (select count(*) from gone), 'pulled', exists (select 1 from landed)) as result
